steps.label: What a sex pilus is
steps.margin_note: Structure, alternative name, which cell makes it.
lines: A SEX PILUS is a hollow tube on the surface of a
It is also called a conjugation tube.
It is produced by the DONOR cell, which is called
steps.why: Only the donor makes the tube, so the pilus is what marks which of the two cells is the donor.
common_mistakes: Saying both cells make a pilus. Only the DONOR (F+) makes it.
Calling it a flagellum. A flagellum moves the cell; a pilus joins two cells.
steps.memory_tip: Only the giver builds the bridge.

steps.label: Its function
steps.margin_note: Name both cell types, the direction, and the process.

lines.text: It carries DNA from the F+ cell to the F− cell

lines: The F+ donor cell uses the pilus to make contact
with the recipient, the F− cell.
Genetic material then passes through the tube
steps.why: Bacteria have no gametes, so a physical tube is the only way one cell can hand genetic material to another.
common_mistakes: Saying DNA passes both ways. It passes from F+ TO F− only.
Not naming conjugation. The process name is part of the mark.
steps.memory_tip: F plus gives, F minus receives.
